orchid.name: Orchid's Iron Guard
orchid.line: Hold the river line. Patience is our blade. We break their charge on our spear tips.

kite.name: General of KITE
kite.line: Steady as the river, we hold the fords—let none cross while we stand firm!

tiger.name: Tiger's Unyielding Claw
tiger.line: Hold the fords, guard the valley, strike when the mist clears.

rhino.name: The Grey Rhino
rhino.line: Slow feet, sealed letters. Nobody reads what we write.
